scenes.title: Новый хозяин  (The New Owner)
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev announces he has sold Claude Monet to Igor Valentinovich, who immediately confronts Chef Viktor about his drinking problem and forbids alcohol at work.

scenes.title: Строгий приказ  (Strict Order)
scenes.summary: Max regrets his mistake with Sasha, and when Victoria arrives at the restaurant, she immediately fires Sasha and orders Max back to the kitchen.

scenes.title: Начало смены  (Start of the Shift)
scenes.summary: Furious after the new owner confiscates all of his alcohol, Chef Viktor orders Max and Senya to stop chatting and start their kitchen shift immediately.

scenes.title: Плохие новости  (Bad News)
scenes.summary: Sasha asks Kristina to intervene with Dmitry Nagiyev after Victoria fires her, but Kristina reveals that she and Dmitry are getting divorced.

scenes.title: Букет цветов  (A Bouquet of Flowers)
scenes.summary: Kostya serves Chef Viktor water instead of alcohol, Max sends Victoria a bouquet of flowers to beg for forgiveness, and Viktor greets guests in the dining room.

scenes.title: Поиски коньяка  (Searching for Cognac)
scenes.summary: After the new owner bans him from drinking, Chef Viktor searches Louis's pastry station and confiscates cognac-filled chocolates from Senya.

scenes.title: Серьёзный разговор  (A Serious Conversation)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant hall, Max begs Victoria to listen to his apology, and when she refuses to speak with him, he blocks her path.

scenes.title: Побег Вики  (Vika's Escape)
scenes.summary: Outside the restaurant, Max locks himself in place to prove his devotion, but Victoria calls him a fool and walks back to work.

scenes.title: Звонок другу  (Calling a Friend)
scenes.summary: Stranded outside after Victoria walks away and having lost the key, Max calls Kostya on the phone and begs him to come rescue him.

scenes.title: Пропавшая бутылка  (The Missing Bottle)
scenes.summary: In his office, Chef Viktor demands to know where his bottle of whiskey went, and Lyova nervously offers him hot tea instead.

scenes.title: Строгий друг  (A Strict Friend)
scenes.summary: Max complains to Kostya that Vika refuses to listen to his apologies, and Kostya bluntly admits he would never forgive a betrayal either.

scenes.title: История про пса  (The Story About the Dog)
scenes.summary: Kostya tells Max he could only forgive someone if misfortune struck them, recalling how he forgave his childhood dog Ralph after a car hit it.

scenes.title: Сухой закон  (Dry Law)
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova accompanies Chef Viktor Barinov to work to keep him from buying alcohol and warns him about the new security camera in the kitchen.
scenes.location: Улица у ресторана (Street outside the restaurant)

scenes.title: Утренний комплимент  (A Morning Compliment)
scenes.summary: New restaurant owner Igor Valentinovich greets Vika in the dining room with a warm morning compliment and jokes gallantly about surrendering to her charm.

scenes.title: Безумный план  (A Crazy Plan)
scenes.summary: Inspired by Kostya's dog story, Max rigs up a fake stunt in the storage room and explains to a startled Kostya how the trick will make Vika forgive him.

scenes.title: Гнев шефа  (The Chef's Anger)
scenes.summary: The angry chef screams at his lazy kitchen staff for leaving a dirty plate. He orders everyone to clean the kitchen immediately while they secretly plot to calm him down with a special spiked drink.

scenes.title: Секретный ингредиент  (The Secret Ingredient)
scenes.summary: The chef tastes the spiked tea and immediately recognizes the hidden alcohol. He praises his sous-chef for the clever trick while Kostya delivers a note to Victoria.

scenes.title: Записка  (The Note)
scenes.summary: Victoria reads the strange note she received from Kostya. She quickly realizes it is from Max and becomes annoyed by his dramatic behavior.

scenes.title: Неудачный спектакль  (The Failed Play)
scenes.summary: Max stages a fake suicide attempt on a high structure to win Victoria's pity. His dangerous stunt goes horribly wrong when he accidentally slips.

scenes.title: Извинения  (Apologies)
scenes.summary: After surviving his accidental hanging, Max sincerely apologizes to Victoria for his foolish stunt. He begs her for another chance to prove his love.

scenes.title: Короткий разговор  (Brief Exchange)
scenes.summary: Max calls out to Vika in the hallway before discussing the plan.

scenes.title: Успешный план  (A Successful Plan)
scenes.summary: Max approaches Vika, oblivious to the situation, and mentions that her trick worked.

scenes.title: Чаепитие шефа  (The Chef's Tea Party)
scenes.summary: Igor Valentinovich notices Chef Barinov calmly drinking tea and makes a passive-aggressive comment.

scenes.title: Больше чая  (More Tea)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov mockingly asks Igor Valentinovich to pour him another cup of tea.

scenes.title: Смена власти  (Shift of Power)
scenes.summary: Igor Valentinovich tries to fire the kitchen staff, but Elena arrives with documents proving she owns the restaurant.
